3132.title: Mobile push routing drops project scope
3132.rootCauseOneLine: The mobile notification response handler parses projectId but builds every WebView path as projectless, so normal project threads are resolved against the personal project and rejected.
3132.proposedFix: Use the shared thread-route helper when projectId is present and keep the projectless route only for legacy payloads that omit it.
3132.caveats: The exact native screen was not observed on physical iOS hardware; the notification callback and emitted route were reproduced directly in two clean checkouts.
